When VSCode's python extensions start up, they try to introspect into the environment to see what virtualenvs are available. In order to support the widest market, the startup script searches for all the known and supported kinds of virtual environments. Unfortunately, it appears that if even one of the versions of python or one of the s errors out during VS Code's startup, it breaks the whole environment discovery process.
